text:
alex: Heads up — Lumen Health just flagged invoice INV-0923 showing a -$12,450 proration line under Reserved Capacity. They reduced committed capacity mid-month and got a net negative invoice (credit). Can someone confirm if this is expected before I tell them we’ll reissue? Link: https://invoices.example/INV-0923 @marta @raj
billing-bot: Invoice INV-0923 generated 2026-03-12T02:03:18Z. Items: Reserved commit (monthly), Burst overage, Proration adjustment, SLA credit. Auto-pay scheduled.
marta: Can you paste the invoice lines or a screenshot? Also need the exact date/time when their commit changed so we can reproduce proration window.
alex: Change happened 2026-03-05 ~08:00 UTC. Screenshot attached in thread. They expect a prorated credit but not a negative invoice that becomes a payable credit on our side.
raj: Quick note — our proration calc is commit_rate * (remaining_days/total_days) by default. There are a couple of edge-cases where credits (SLA or burst refunds) can exceed charges and result in negative net. I'll pull metering and the invoice generation logs. @lisa-csm fyi.
marta: I pulled the invoice. Snippet of line items: ```
INV-0923 line items:
- Reserved commit (Mar 1-31) 32 units @ $15/unit = $14,880.00
- Proration credit (reduce 32->18 from Mar 5) = -$7,200.00
- Burst overage (Mar 1-5) = $1,830.00
- SLA credit (service outage Mar 2) = -$1,080.00
- Total due = -$12,450.00
```
alex: So SLA credit + proration > reserved charge in the current ledger which produced the negative total. Lumen says they can’t accept a negative invoice as a refund and want a corrected invoice or a separate credit memo.
raj: I found the bug in the proration window calculation — when the commit change occurs during DST transition week we were using an inclusive window that doubled the prorated days in rare cases; that inflated the proration credit. I’ll open a billing ticket and prepare a patch. Plan: revert the incorrect proration, re-run invoice generator, and issue a corrected invoice (INV-0923-R1) plus a separate credit memo if needed.
marta: Sounds good. I'll hold collections and disable auto-pay for this account until the reissue is processed. Need approval to issue a corrected invoice and a manual credit memo for the small residuals. @finance-approvals please sign off. Estimated impact to March revenue: ~$12.45k adjustment (credit currently, will correct).
lisa-csm: I’ll tell the Lumen billing contact to hold off on any payment / refund processing. Apologize for confusion and share ETA once you have it, Raj.
raj: Created internal ticket BILL-4521. Work items: 1) Patch proration calc, 2) Re-generate invoice with corrected proration, 3) Create credit memo if net negative persists, 4) Run reconciliation and backfill reporting. ETA 48 hours (target 2026-03-14T18:00:00Z).
marta: Thanks. After reissue I’ll reconcile revenue and confirm refund/credit handling with accounting. Leaving a note to waive any late fees for Lumen for this cycle.
alex: Thanks team — please @mention me when the corrected invoice is out so I can notify the customer.
